text:
sara.chen: Heads-up — during the int4 canary for rwd-v6 we hit the attenuation logic at ~12% traffic. Overall numbers look OK but long-doc summarization slice shows a notable ROUGE-L drop; need a quick decision on abort/pause/throttle.

vik: Can you paste the canary config and the gating rules? Also which metrics are primary — long_doc_rouge-L, hybrid-mrr, latency tail?

sara.chen: Posting config snippet from rollout manifest:
```yaml
canary:
  frac: 0.12
  metrics:
    - name: long_doc_rouge-L
      delta_threshold: -0.06
      sample_size: 1200
  attenuation:
    type: step
    steps: [0.12, 0.06, 0.02]
    trigger: rolling_window_30m
hysteresis: 0.10 # 10% hold before re-escalation
min_hold_time: 7200 # seconds
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started rwd-v6-int4 @ pods=20; initial smoke ok. latency p50=60ms p95=180ms.

priya: We see a ~6.8% drop on long_doc_rouge-L vs baseline in the last 20k requests. Also codegen slice hallucination score ticked up (small absolute but consistent). My recommendation: auto-fallback threshold at -5% (i.e. delta_threshold: -0.05), attenuate to 5% traffic then shadow for 24h.

mike: -5% auto-fallback is sane but watch oscillation. Suggest adding:
- min_hold_time: 2h (no re-promote before this)
- backoff multiplier: 0.5 for attenuation steps (so we don't drop too fast)
- require absolute failing_count >= 500 over window before triggering
- smooth metrics with EWMA alpha=0.2 to reduce noisy spikes
this prevents transient blips from causing rollbacks.

sara.chen: Agree. Also noticed correlation with prefix-cache-hit rate on those long-doc requests — cache_hit ~0.12 during the window. Could be that int4 kv-cache behavior is amplifying mismatch. Add cache-hit as a secondary gating metric.

vik: Clear. Action items:
- priya: run focused eval on 1,200 long-docs + 800 codegen slices (priority sampling) and post confusion breakdown.
- mike: push attenuation config change (min_hold_time=7200, backoff=0.5, fail_count_threshold=500, ewma smoothing).
- sara: reduce live canary frac -> 6% (hold) until focused eval lands. If regression persists > -5% after 2 hours -> automatic rollback.

priya: On it. Running the focused eval now (local cluster q3). ETA ~45m, will post raw vs baseline and sample ids.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary attenuation applied: frac -> 0.06 at 5423456792. Observability dashboard link: https://console.redwood.ai/models/rwd-v6/canary/charts (charts + diffs).

sara.chen: Thanks — keep me posted. If priya sees that the loss concentrates on missing prefix tokens, we might instead try a hybrid run (int4 for short context, int8 for long-docs) as a stopgap.

mike: +1 to hybrid split, and add automatic shadowing when attenuated so we keep telemetry for longer.

priya: Quick note — the early eval shows 640 failing examples (per our failure definition) with avg delta -6.5% on ROUGE-L. Uploading sample ids now.

sara.chen: Ok that crosses the 500 threshold we defined. Given the magnitude and count, initiate rollback if the EWMA stays below -5% for next 30m.

vik: I'll update the runbook to reflect the new gates (fail_count + ewma + min_hold). We should also tag the model release with 'attenuation-tested' and record the cache_hit correlation for postmortem.

sara.chen: 👍 adding to runbook.

priya: Result update (5423456795): After attenuation and additional eval, ROUGE-L delta stabilized at -5.2% EWMA; hallucination rate reduced a bit when we shadowed int8 for long-docs. Recommending rollback to previous stable int8 baseline and iterate on kv-cache alignment for the next int4 attempt.

mike: Acknowledged. I'll open a short ticket for hybrid fallback + cache alignment experiments.

sara.chen: Rolling back per policy. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
